The '''Rhand system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Perann Nebula/Legends|Perann Nebula]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhand]].
